meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每调用一次 Bash 工具,命令都会先经 rtk 代理压缩再执行,可减少 token 消耗,对 git、cargo、pytest 等命令节省 60–90% 的 token。
howto.when: 当 Claude 调用 Bash 工具执行命令时自动触发,覆盖 git、cargo、pytest 等命令。

say.text: 给当前 agent 组安装 rtk 代理
say.note: 会完成安装、挂载并添加 hook。

say.text: 把 rtk 挂载到容器并重启
say.note: 挂载后重启使配置生效。

say.text: 让 Bash 命令自动走 rtk 压缩
say.note: 所有 Bash 调用都会被 rtk 过滤。

howto.what_en: Once installed, every Bash tool call Claude makes is routed through the rtk proxy to compress output, saving 60–90% tokens on dev commands like git, cargo, pytest, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically whenever Claude invokes a Bash tool call, covering commands like git, cargo, pytest, etc.

say_en.text: Install the rtk proxy for the current agent group.
say_en.note: Runs installation, mount, and hook setup.

say_en.text: Mount rtk into the container and restart the group.
Make Bash commands go through rtk compression.
say_en.note: All Bash calls will be filtered by rtk.
